"""Nickel rounding for the pricing report."""

# Halfway between two nickels is at x.5 cents, which integer cent amounts
# can never hit, so round-half-up and round-to-nearest agree here.
_HALF_NICKEL = 2  # cents; added before floor-division to round to nearest


def round_to_nickel(cents):
    """Round an integer cent amount to the nearest 5 cents.

    23 cents rounds to 25, 22 cents rounds to 20. Works for negative
    amounts (e.g. refunds) too.
    """
    return ((cents + _HALF_NICKEL) // 5) * 5

    Kept around until the v1 receipt migration finishes; delegates to
    :func:`round_to_nickel` so old callers pick up the corrected rounding.
    """
    return round_to_nickel(cents)

content.text:
All green. Here's what I changed.

## The actual bug

`round_to_nickel` was flooring to the multiple below instead of rounding to nearest, contradicting its own docstring (`23 → 25`, `22 → 20`). The old body:

```python
return (cents // 5) * 5
```

gave `round_to_nickel(23) == 20`, failing `test_rounds_up_to_nearest`.

## Fix

`repo/pricing.py` now rounds to nearest using integer math:

```python
_HALF_NICKEL = 2  # cents; added before floor-division to round to nearest

def round_to_nickel(cents):
    return ((cents + _HALF_NICKEL) // 5) * 5
```

Why `+ 2`: the midpoint between two nickels sits at `x.5` cents, which integer cent inputs can never hit, so adding 2 before floor-division is exactly round-to-nearest with no ties to worry about (round-half-up ≡ round-to-nearest here). It also handles negatives (refunds) correctly: `round_to_nickel(-3) == -5`, `round_to_nickel(-2) == 0`.

## Related helpers tidied

- `repo/pricing.py` — `old_round` kept as a clearly-marked legacy alias that delegates to the corrected `round_to_nickel` (so v1 receipt callers pick up the fix without code changes). Didn't delete it — the TODO says "remove after migration" and I have no signal that migration is done.
- `repo/format.py` — `format_row` replaced the manual `while len(s) < 8: s = s + " "` padding loop with `str.ljust`, behavior-identical (8-wide cells, trailing `|`). Verified `format_row(['a','bb','cccccccc']) == 'a       |bb      |cccccccc|'`.

## Fix

`repo/pricing.py` now rounds to nearest using integer math:

```python
_HALF_NICKEL = 2  # cents; added before floor-division to round to nearest

def round_to_nickel(cents):
    return ((cents + _HALF_NICKEL) // 5) * 5
```

Why `+ 2`: the midpoint between two nickels sits at `x.5` cents, which integer cent inputs can never hit, so adding 2 before floor-division is exactly round-to-nearest with no ties to worry about (round-half-up ≡ round-to-nearest here). It also handles negatives (refunds) correctly: `round_to_nickel(-3) == -5`, `round_to_nickel(-2) == 0`.
